# jev-eval fixtures

Fixtures for `tests/jev-category-eval.bats`. Only `frontmatter-expected.json`
comes from an outside reference; everything else is hand-built, so passing
tests show the script agrees with these files, not that it matches
TypeSafe's live API.

| Path | Source |
|---|---|
| `frontmatter/*.md` | Hand-written YAML shapes taken from real `docs/solutions/` frontmatter (continued quoted titles, `>-` blocks, flow lists on the next line, `''` escapes). `err-*.md` are inputs the parser must reject. |
| `frontmatter-expected.json` | Generated by PyYAML 6.0.3 `BaseLoader` (every value a string) from the non-`err-` files above. Regenerate with the command below after changing a fixture. |
| `repo/` | Hand-built `docs/solutions/` tree; bats copies it and runs `git init` and `git add` in `setup`. |
| `report-results.jsonl` | Hand-built results rows plus a summary record, for `report`. Its `criteria_sha` is the placeholder `fixture-sha`, which the tests replace with the current criteria file's sha. |
| `stub_server.py` | Stand-in endpoint. Its response shape copies a real `jev-1.13.0` answer recorded on 2026-10-14 (`model`, `answers.category.{choice, confidence, probabilities}`, `usage.input_tokens`); its scenarios are invented failure modes. |

Regenerate the golden file (needs `uv`; run from the repository root):

```bash
uv run --no-project --with pyyaml==6.0.3 python3 - plugins/yellow-core/tests/fixtures/jev-eval/frontmatter \
  >| plugins/yellow-core/tests/fixtures/jev-eval/frontmatter-expected.json <<'PY'
import glob, json, os, sys, yaml
out = {}
for p in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(sys.argv[1], "*.md"))):
    name = os.path.basename(p)
    if name.startswith("err-"):
        continue
    fm = open(p, encoding="utf-8").read().split("\n---\n", 1)[0][4:]
    y = yaml.load(fm, Loader=yaml.BaseLoader)
    out[name] = {k: y.get(k) or ([] if k == "tags" else "") for k in ("title", "problem", "tags", "date")}
print(json.dumps(out, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
PY
```

The same comparison over every tracked `docs/solutions/` doc matched on
2026-10-14 apart from one doc both parsers reject; it is not part of the
suite because the corpus changes.
